snippet.title: Rabbit Rush - Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description: Rabbit Rush is a fast and intense action game, where the player controls an agile, specific rabbit who needs to complete each stage in just 10 seconds. Take your katana and sharp carrot and eliminate all enemies.
